full_judgment: 4. The learned assistant judge, Rajapur, at Jhalakati, heard the case and was pleased to decree the suit for khas possession by his judgment and decree dated 26-2-2001, directing the defendant opposite party No.1 to shift the house from the suit land. Against this judgment and decree, the opposite party No.1 filed Title Appeal No. 42 of 2001 in the Court of District Judge, Jhalakati. The applications one for exemption of the service of notice upon the respondent Nos. 2-5 and for staying the operation of the judgment and decree dated 26-2-2001 passed in title Suit No. 63 of 1999 by the trial Court were also filed. The learned District Judge, Jhalakati, by order on 30-4-2001 admitted the appeal, rejected the prayer for exemption of the service of notice upon the respondent Nos. 2-5 and allowed the application for stay of the operation of the judgment and decree dated 26-2-2001. Against the said order dated 30-4-2001, regarding the admission of the appeal and staying the operation of the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court, the plaintiff petitioner filed this revisional application and obtained the Rule.
